Name: Custom Dark Fence
Author: Billy0815
Description:
Hello,

this is a simple mod which change the normal wooden fence.

If you want to replace an other fence just change fence1.xnb to
[list]
[*][size=3][size=2]fence2.xnb -> stone fence[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2]fence3.xnb -> iron fence[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2]fence5.xnb -> hardwood fence[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2]
[u][b][size=4]Installation:[/size][/b][/u]
Copy [u]fence1.xnb[/u] to [b]Stardew Valley/Content/LooseSprites.[/b]

[size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2]Copy [u]springobjects.xnb [/u]to [b]Stardew Valley/Content/Maps.

Be aware that some languages use their own "[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][u]springobjects.xnb"[/u].[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
If your language use a separate springobects file feel free to contact me to solve that.
[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

[u][size=4][b]This mod is part of my upcoming farm building modpack. I'm uploading it separately for a better organization.[/b][/size]
[/u]
[u][b][size=4]Attention:
[/size][/b][/u]I changed the size of the pickets due to an little error the original fence had.
This lead to some incompatibilities with the gate if you place it in certain places like a corner for example.
You can bypass this issue when you place the gate on a straight line of pickets. I think this is not a big deal but I felt like you should know that.
